name: edit_take
description: Apply free deterministic edits to an owned Sketch or Code take using stable target IDs from get_take.structure. Pull the take first and supply its exact version to avoid overwriting newer changes. Code supports literal JSX text, element styles, visibility, image URLs/alt, locks and static subtree duplication/moves/removal within one JSX tree. Remove physically deletes an unlocked static subtree and prunes its current notes; old saved versions remain intact. Clones get fresh source and DOM IDs. Dynamic JSX, handlers/imported components and unsupported global tokens require an explicit AI note; no paid fallback runs. Locked files and active generation are protected. Returns a confirmed saved version with zero credits; never invokes a paid fallback.

notes.description: Optional complete notes list. New notes get a server-stamped author. Use ops:[] for free notes-only saving. Existing IDs preserve authoritative author and status; refs bind exact immutable same-project versions.

purpose.description: Editable saved part plan; requires a UUID note ID and exact part root target.

items.description: image/link require HTTP(S) url; take requires exact positive take/version and optional saved id; component requires author/component slug. Planned component intent additionally requires exact demoId, published reusable license/ACL and a saved unique part-targeted UUID note. Server binds references/stamps authors; planned never proves installation.

alt.description: Image only: plain alternative text. Omit to preserve; use an empty string for a decorative image. With no value, change only alt and preserve the saved src/srcset.

anchor.description: Existing saved destination address for move.

media.description: Exact target override at widths up to 639px. Code requires a uniquely mounted static native element in the proven default App source; unsupported responsive source needs a note.
